submission_requirements: README: project, setup, architecture, Midnight integration, how judges test
Description of progress completed during the Wave
`midnightntwrk` topic label on the GitHub repo
required_integrations: Compact smart contract that compiles (HARD GATE)

demo_video_requirements.content_notes: Rules require 'a demo / video pitch' and score Communication at 10% for 'clarity and structure of the video presentation and slide deck'. No explicit max length published. [ASSUMED] 2-4 min is the safe target.

disqualifiers: No Compact contract that compiles successfully -> AUTOMATIC DQ from judging for that Wave
Mere fork, copy, or superficial modification of an existing project
Missing public GitHub repo, slide deck, or demo video
Midnight-related code not under Apache License 2.0
Under 18; sanctioned jurisdictions (AF, BY, CU, IR, IQ, KP, RU, SY, VE, YE, MM, SO, SD)
Multiple accounts to submit duplicate entries

workshops.name: Midnight Buildathon Kickoff Workshop
workshops.speaker: Midnight team
workshops.topic: Midnight tech walkthrough + what judges score
workshops.strategy_signal: Organizer explicitly walked through 'exactly what judges score' — the published rubric IS the strategy. Engineering 40% dominates.

sponsor_bounties.requirements: Privacy-first app with >=1 compiling Compact contract; private state management; dual-ledger model understanding
sponsor_bounties.integration_depth_bar: Engineering & Implementation is 40% of score and explicitly checks: contract compiles, private state management present, dual-ledger model understood, repo organized, README clear, repo tagged with Midnight topics, ecosystem attribution included.

sidetracks.name: Midnight Build Club
sidetracks.eligibility: Teams selected by judges. 8-week part-time program for high-potential idea-stage projects; senior experts in software/BD/marketing; ends in pitch to Midnight's investor network + Midnight Accelerator Program.

network.deploy_requirement: NOT required. Rules require the contract to COMPILE, not to be deployed. Technical Gate says 'at least one Compact contract that compiles successfully'.

prizes.notes: Point-proportional split across ALL eligible submissions, not winner-take-all. 59 submissions.
